answer: The strongest lever is simple: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because jetty only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, sable is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any trellis approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
